item.description:
DuoBee 2.0.1

A small user-interface cleanup release. No functional or security changes.

Fixed

  • Removed the duplicate About DuoBee and DuoBee Help items from the Window menu. Both remain in their proper places: DuoBee → About DuoBee and Help → DuoBee Help.
  • Removed the redundant Close button from the bottom of the About window.

Changed

  • In-app text in the About and Help windows now uses the generic term "authenticator".

DuoBee 2.0.0

This release corrects the project's licensing and identity. It contains no feature changes.

License changed to AGPL-3.0-or-later

DuoBee is derived from DuoBreak by Jesse Naser, which is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or later. Earlier releases were incorrectly distributed under an MIT license; from 2.0.0 DuoBee is licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later, and each release carries a source archive of the exact commit it was built from.

Copyright attribution corrected

Releases 1.0.0–1.3.0 named an incorrect copyright holder. The holder is now correctly stated as Michael Bino; see the NOTICE file for the full record.

Bundle identifier changed

The app's identifier is now io.bino.duobee. Earlier builds are treated as a different application: they are never offered this update automatically, and their database and saved keychain password do not carry over.

Coming from 1.x? Install 2.0.0 manually and delete the old copy. Export your database from the old app (Database → Export) and import it in 2.0.0, then enter your database password once to save it again.
